data.narrative:
Space Machines Company is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised AU$11M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage comparables for direct triangulation.

Two standard valuation methods cannot be reliably applied. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector—while 11 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet the filtering criteria for meaningful statistical anchoring. Public-comp anchoring is inapplicable because target revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S of 23.9x across the 6 public tickers cannot be deployed without the company's top-line figures.

This analysis does not yield a definitive valuation range. Proceeding would require either: disclosure of Space Machines Company's revenue or credible forward projections, access to transaction multiples or post-money valuations from the identified private peer set, or a broader sector median if narrower comparability is unachievable. The AU$11M raised to date establishes a minimum post-money baseline but does not itself imply enterprise value. Further due diligence on comparable round sizes, burn profile, and market traction in the Space & Aerospace subsegment is necessary before quantitative triangulation can be responsibly completed.
